about: A made-up evening for the browser checks of the Live view (checks/feed.py serves it by cursor). Its twelve moments are the recorded evening's own (demo/recordings/evening_2025-01-28), built by the page builder and put into the feed's wire forms, so every card, line, path and box id is one the page already draws. Made up: the choice of the twelve; the clock time of two of them (the morning moment stands at 10:00, 96 quarter-hours after the contracts, and the words to the owner at 19:00, as a surprise); the surprise's tag; the timeline, its six stops and the two leaps. A moment of more than 24 steps keeps its first 24, as a live moment closes there.
